name: only session in the window
note: One session and two commits share a repository and a time window, but they share no files and the commits have no branch. The session is the only one in the window, so both commits join it. Nothing in the status rules matches, so the status stays empty.

work_items.title: First note
work_items.because: The commits have no branch, pull request, or ticket. The title is the earlier commit subject.

events.because: No other session overlaps this window, and the commits have no files or branch to match more specifically.
The commit is inside the session start through two hours after the session end.
The second commit is in the same window and there is still only one session.
